an3.24:1.3: Yaṃ bhikkhave puggalaṃ āgamma puggalo buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti,
an3.24:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave yaṃ puggalaṃ āgamma puggalo idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . . dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
an3.24:2.2: ayaṃ bhikkhave puggalo imassa puggalassa bahukāro.
an3.24:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave yaṃ puggalaṃ āgamma puggalo āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ ceto-vimuttiṃ paññā-vimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati,
an3.24:3.3: Ime kho bhikkhave tayo puggalā puggalassa bahukārā.
an3.24:4.1: Imehi ca pana bhikkhave tīhi puggalehi imassa puggalassa n' atthi añño puggalo bahukārataro ti vadāmi.
an3.24:4.2: Imesañ ca bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ iminā puggalena na suppaṭikāraṃ vadāmī ti, yadidaṃ abhivādana-paccuṭṭhāna-añjalikamma-sāmīcikamma-
